{"id": "e154ab0d-db4c-4fb6-ba53-bcb651977033", "value": "En arch\u00e9ologie, ce terme tend \u00e0 \u00eatre utilis\u00e9 dans son sens le plus large pour signifier le transfert de biens entre les communaut\u00e9s, sachant que de nombreux m\u00e9canismes sociaux diff\u00e9rents peuvent \u00eatre \u00e0 l'origine de ces mouvements.Voir aussi \u00e9change (exchange)."}

{"id": "f8e2c2a3-0cf7-4fca-9bfb-3f148186711a", "value": "In archaeology this term tends to be used in its broadest sense to mean
 the transfer of goods between communities, recognizing that many different
 social mechanisms may be responsible for those movements. See also
 Exchange."}
{"id": "39fd5e8c-93a7-41d8-95c9-6e896dc8633c", "value": "A sloping platform or ramp leading to a body water and used to move watercraft in and out of the water"}
{"id": "c4f6ec5a-c1ff-4abe-87bc-1b04041914ea", "value": "The Hypogeum, or underground cavity, is a unique monument and superb example of architecture in the negative"}
{"id": "5fb0ee76-8c6e-49b7-a177-d5d36065e679", "value": "L'Hypog\u00e9e, ou cavit\u00e9 souterraine, est un monument unique et un superbe exemple d'architecture dans le n\u00e9gatif = souterrain ?"}

{"id": "3f26ac22-59ea-4099-b566-63bacafb8028", "value": "Circular or other stone outline, with stones generally placed on ground or (less frequently) embedded in ground, and not necessarily close together."}
{"id": "ec506c67-a635-4cb2-b692-f33fd243751d", "value": "Similar to a particularly wide cresent. A gentle concave exedra is characteristic of the front face."}

{"id": "b47ed186-c785-41e3-9672-2abbbe4d803e", "value": "P\u00e9rim\u00e8tre visible d\u00e9limitant l'\u00e9tendue de la zone de labourage, g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement marqu\u00e9 par des murs de pierre, des foss\u00e9s, des haies, des berges ou des arbres/arbustes."}
{"id": "9e588305-cb52-417a-b2cd-b9de8f34dffa", "value": "visible perimetre dermacating the extent of the ploughing area, usually marked by stone walls, ditches, hedges, banks or trees/shrubs."}

{"id": "c9e101a5-4915-4713-b1a1-ff27751ad2f7", "value": "An artifical waterway constructed for the purposes of cutting across a drainage divide, making access or movement of water or vessels between two drainage basins possible or conveying water and/or ships inland"}

{"id": "39ed37c2-6541-4f05-9d93-4608d442e32e", "value": "Designated path leading into and out of the Kaya through the
gates (mvirya). No other means of access was allowed and
deviation from the path or use of other tracks indicated enmity or
evil intent"}

{"id": "e50dc656-e445-4b8d-917a-b2bc06a52860", "value": "Les m\u00e9galithes sont des monuments fun\u00e9raires am\u00e9nag\u00e9es uniquement avec des pierres de grande dimension, avec du bois ou avec des pierres associ\u00e9es avec de la terre. Leurs architectures varient souvent en fonction des r\u00e9gions et, ainsi, ils peuvent \u00eatre des menhirs, des dolmens, des monolithes ou des all\u00e9es couvertes."}

{"id": "c2e9b694-41d6-45ff-9d47-5a7e9456ed1b", "value": "Megaliths are funerary monuments built only with large stones, with wood or with stones combined with earth. Their architecture often varies according to the region and, thus, they can be menhirs, dolmens, monoliths or covered walkways."}

{"id": "0df49a28-a2ab-4319-a8b8-724d21ab9262", "value": "Une banlieue ou une ville \u00e0 pr\u00e9dominance noire, anciennement d\u00e9sign\u00e9e officiellement pour l'occupation noire par la l\u00e9gislation de l'apartheid"}
{"id": "87c1f689-0425-4e51-999a-af5d92dfc168", "value": "A suburb or city of predominantly black occupation, formerly officially designated for black occupation by apartheid legislation"}
{"id": "81f9f7bb-b964-4a67-80f4-2a2cf4447f80", "value": "Alternative to Pottery Scatter. Generally a surface find comprised of a small area of potsherds."}

{"id": "6c3c1865-16b3-44c6-a4b7-b07185df3021", "value": "Alternative \u00e0 la dispersion de poterie. Il s'agit g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement d'une d\u00e9couverte de surface compos\u00e9e d'une petite zone de tessons de poterie."}
{"id": "4a2d1dd9-6f8d-4bf2-aa5d-233c7041283e", "value": "Used for an unknown function. This value should only be chosen when there are no other values for \"Function\"."}

{"id": "ca2b3575-83d1-4324-8f3d-7171a599ba15", "value": "Utilis\u00e9 pour une fonction inconnue / ind\u00e9termin\u00e9e. Cette valeur ne doit \u00eatre choisie que lorsqu'il n'y a pas d'autres valeurs pour \"Fonction\"."}
{"id": "7e804fcf-b156-4b2c-84a9-559c0d9cb9a2", "value": "A complex of field boundaries forming a coherent and discrete unit"}
{"id": "758ee561-ec5f-4292-8bb9-b69793255833", "value": "A man-made receptacle for holding liquids, often associated with agricultural processing (e.g. oil or wine). This includes cupmarks/cupholes"}
{"id": "70eba8b3-8927-4fdb-888c-ff106083334e", "value": "A temporary habitation locale"}
{"id": "0c6c2d16-c9e8-4d0f-ab4d-a0f6bf929246", "value": "A heap of earth placed over one or more prehistoric tombs, often surrounded by ditches"}
{"id": "431435ad-a820-4601-964c-61ef6aaaf73f", "value": "Un tas de terre plac\u00e9 sur une ou plusieurs tombes pr\u00e9historiques, souvent entour\u00e9 de foss\u00e9s."}
{"id": "6cf33e2f-f35c-4665-98cb-e51c224ee3e3", "value": "A structure designed to enable one to cross over a barrier or obstacle, such as a body of water, chasm, etc."}
{"id": "f87a63f3-ca19-4c25-b9f8-57e1b6a6f2bb", "value": "Les dolmens sont constitu\u00e9s de deux ou plusieurs pierres verticales sur lesquelles repose une seule pierre."}
{"id": "0f208bbe-2cfc-45be-8004-a97809923c92", "value": "Dolmens are made of two or more upright stones with a single stone lying across them."}

{"id": "b86ab3ec-01a9-4cda-8a18-4bedf71aa7a7", "value": "Alternative \u00e0 l'enclos pour le b\u00e9tail. Un enclos pour les bovins ou les ovins.\n Kraal: Enclos destin\u00e9 au b\u00e9tail en Afrique du Sud."}
{"id": "a4544449-e76c-4826-bd8e-5c6388ed7566", "value": "Alternative to livestock enclosure. An enclosure for cattle or sheep."}
{"id": "207fdb9c-90e1-46fc-bc10-c5e1f7242f76", "value": "an enclosed structure usually constructed of clay, and used for smelting metal at high temperatures"}

{"id": "0723ab73-7597-49f3-aa04-8796d87624dc", "value": "une structure ferm\u00e9e, g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement construite en argile, et utilis\u00e9e pour fondre du m\u00e9tal \u00e0 haute temp\u00e9rature."}
{"id": "5df4c9b7-101e-4792-8ee5-31a51f879ff6", "value": "Utilis\u00e9 pour stocker de l'eau - par exemple, une citerne ou un r\u00e9servoir artificiel."}
{"id": "191ef64f-c4a7-4958-b444-0bf9be137092", "value": "Used to store water - for example, a cistern or artificiel reservoir."}
{"id": "eb20c522-50db-4194-8ffd-b79252ead279", "value": "Tumulus truncated to create fl at top. In Niger, 3\u201320m \u00d7 0.5\u20134m, with burial in a chamber in most cases (BANI 1994)."}

{"id": "ec8db164-cb91-4a83-bb37-ed7b97657703", "value": "D\u00e9pressions d\u00e9sertiques ferm\u00e9es. On les trouve dans certaines situations g\u00e9omorphologiques caract\u00e9ristiques, notamment dans les zones interdunaires, les anciens chenaux de rivi\u00e8re et les lits de lac d\u00e9gonfl\u00e9s."}

{"id": "cb5817a1-9149-4d1b-8ff7-49a79bb0a03e", "value": "Closed desert depressions. They occur in certain characteristic geomorphological situations, including interdunal areas, old river channels, and deflated lake beds"}
{"id": "58109087-b2be-4b92-a092-e0ae1d2496f5", "value": "Small pile of stones or cairn, too small to be described as a tumulus"}

{"id": "cd82b598-cc7e-4e1c-89a3-2c8d4f4b7415", "value": "Assemblages compos\u00e9s d'outils en pierre et d'os provenant d'un seul animal ou de plusieurs animaux de la m\u00eame esp\u00e8ce, sugg\u00e9rant des pratiques de boucherie pass\u00e9es"}

{"id": "ee06ff9f-e0eb-4e2a-bd01-9b77a66da86b", "value": "Assemblages consisting of stone tools and bones from a single animal or several animals of the same species suggesting past butchery practices"}
{"id": "1b611a75-cf9c-4264-a643-c7b97c004bc4", "value": "A covered building for walkway lined with columns"}

{"id": "b66fde19-5c78-4a90-b242-b57aec8f652c", "value": "La séparation du métal du minerai, généralement par chauffage dans un foyer ou un four. Il s'agit d'un processus majeur dans le travail des métaux, produisant le métal utilisable pour la fabrication d'objets.
 Après la fonte, le cuivre peut être coulé et le fer peut être
 forgé. La principale réaction chimique lors de la fusion de la plupart des
 minerais utilisés dans l'Antiquité est celle de la réduction d'un oxyde métallique.
 Si le minerai n'était pas déjà sous forme d'oxyde, il serait alors converti
 par un processus préliminaire. Un contrôle minutieux de la quantité d'air
 entrant dans le fourneau était nécessaire pour réussir
 la fonte. Les vestiges du processus de fusion comprennent des lingots, des
 scories, des tuyères, des foyers contenant des scories et des cendres, et des fours plus sophistiqués."}

{"id": "cd465c9c-93dc-4e5d-bdf6-d894eecadc8a", "value": "Copper smelting furnaces are of notable diversity in design and size. One group is made up of slag tapping tall shaft furnaces, reaching a height of 1.75 metres equipped with at least four tuy\u00e8re ports, were documented ethnographically in Central Africa amongst Sanga people, who produced copper at a large-scale until the nineteenth century (Bisson 1997). Another group is that of non-slag tapping, short shaft furnaces with a single tuy\u00e8re port entrance, employed in the northern parts of South Africa (van der Merwe & Scully 1971; Grant & Huffman 2007). Another group is that of simple bowl furnaces without clay superstructures were used for copper smelting during the seventeenth century AD in eastern Botswana (Huffman et al. 1995). The number and form of the tuy\u00e8res varied, from flared clay pipes to hollowed out anthills and tubes\n fashioned out of stone (Miller & van der Merwe 1994a)."}
{"id": "7469c1a1-cb5d-4d75-8c19-22b8ab16ff53", "value": "Standing structure or device used to catch fish"}
{"id": "3a0cd0d0-ca32-42c2-b545-710dc4d2317e", "value": "Equivalent to an altar, identified site for special prayer, especially"}
{"id": "2dacb2a5-2378-45a0-a37f-5feb4ba40b1a", "value": "Muraille (mur d'enceinte) entourant une ville"}
{"id": "101c8329-1790-42f0-91ac-287cd52ec4aa", "value": "A wall that encloses the outer edge of a town"}
{"id": "698c1f1a-7000-4044-b47f-610983fcb85c", "value": "Un monticule de pierres empil\u00e9es pour marquer un emplacement."}
{"id": "897c07bc-5c8f-40bc-b576-a82ee386bbac", "value": "A mound of stones piled up to mark a location"}
{"id": "a1d2b7e3-c256-43db-98e4-727c52eaa561", "value": "Un site utilis\u00e9 pour les rituels d'\u00e9vocation de la pluie"}
{"id": "4d3fd20f-fbba-47c3-82d5-cae657658b4c", "value": "A site used for rain making rituals"}

{"id": "a146925c-f553-49de-955a-eb97e37462ea", "value": "Features or Structures designed to control the flow and movement of water. This term should only be used when there is no other term existing in the glossary that can be used to more accurately describe the feature(s)/structure(s)"}
{"id": "d6953ff2-62a3-426f-94dc-91d701873ea6", "value": "Cimeti\u00e8re compos\u00e9 de tombes avec des restes qui ont \u00e9t\u00e9 incin\u00e9r\u00e9s."}
{"id": "732d9c7b-39ca-4302-bb01-fc994641b64d", "value": "Cemetery consisting of graves with remains that have been cremated"}

{"id": "3cffa916-132a-4a80-b2f6-5f645261fb77", "value": "Permet de traiter et de forger le m\u00e9tal \u00e0 partir d'une forme pure pour en faire des formes distinctes (par exemple, des armes, des outils, des objets d\u00e9coratifs)."}
{"id": "5deb8351-a833-42ee-8ca0-a90786d890d7", "value": "Used to treat and forge metal from a pure form into distinct forms (e.g. weapons, tools, decorative objects)."}
{"id": "0c000d3a-fef7-46a8-95ae-501bf611e167", "value": "Location where ships/boats can be beached to on/offload people and cargo"}

{"id": "6bf56bda-7abb-42cd-91a8-38a0fe411624", "value": "Grain storage facilities of various forms characterised by a wooden frame that is plastered with suitable clay and were located in cave\n recesses, rock overhangs, and in some instances, concealed a wooden palisade to cover the cave entrance"}

{"id": "059fcb33-9f7f-4ccf-a051-d1ccd9757a45", "value": "Les installations de stockage du grain, de formes diverses, caract\u00e9ris\u00e9es par une structure en bois enduite d'argile appropri\u00e9e, \u00e9taient situ\u00e9es dans des grottes, des surplombs rocheux et, dans certains cas, cachaient une palissade en bois couvrant l'entr\u00e9e de la grotte,\n des cavit\u00e9s, des surplombs rocheux et, dans certains cas, dissimulaient une palissade en bois pour couvrir l'entr\u00e9e de la grotte."}

{"id": "b49b418f-44c5-4c08-9dcf-5cee725283bf", "value": "Grand trou, g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement circulaire et dot\u00e9 d'un muraillement, creus\u00e9 dans la terre pour atteindre la nappe aquif\u00e8re souterraine (nappe libre ou phr\u00e9atique). (https://www.larousse.fr/dictionnaires/francais/puits/65026)"}

{"id": "5ce6857e-9126-47bf-8020-f36a44ff7716", "value": "A large hole, usually circular and walled, dug in the ground to reach the underground water table (open water or groundwater). (translation ofhttps://www.larousse.fr/dictionnaires/francais/puits/650266"}
{"id": "0910433b-1cbe-4983-96d9-3bed3a98687f", "value": "A rotating structure used for to control, manage, and/or lift water; not including milling"}

{"id": "9f51ee36-e8af-4f65-95f2-425a18e8a341", "value": "An articulated monument, with a generally east oriented opening in the outer perimeter ,usually composed of a tumulus surrounded by two rings of stones, the outer being elliptical and the inner circular in shape, centred on the western focalpoint of the ellipse. A sort of corridor runs along the major axis of the outer ring up to the tumulus, andthis gives to the monument the aspect of a keyhole. Opening has also been recorded between East. and South."}
{"id": "1dd1bbad-9199-48b7-b3f4-6868218a16b7", "value": "The starting point of a visit to the Kaya"}

{"id": "391ff85c-e3c7-455e-b1ae-c9d7cfbe3f1b", "value": "M\u00e9thode d'irrigation dans laquelle l'eau est achemin\u00e9e dans de petits foss\u00e9s, sillons ou ondulations, g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement rapproch\u00e9s les uns des autres pour permettre une p\u00e9n\u00e9tration lat\u00e9rale entre eux. (A Dictionary of agricultural and allied terminology. John N. Winburne, r\u00e9dacteur en chef, 1962, Michigan State University Press, 1962, Michigan)"}

{"id": "ecaa35c0-5f3d-4c26-befa-253bc88afa18", "value": "A method of irrigation in which water is run in a small ditches, furrow or corrugation, ussually palced close together to afford lateral penetration between them. (A Dictionary of agricultural and allied terminology. John N. Winburne, editor-in-chief, 1962, Michigan State University Press, 1962, Michigan)"}

{"id": "477e15de-d343-4c37-a3f5-d1cf011c11a1", "value": "Used for the residential needs of a specific individual or group of individuals of a higher status/position in society - for instance, a palace."}

{"id": "002522db-8e2f-457c-b49e-e5aeefcc6764", "value": "Utilis\u00e9e pour les besoins r\u00e9sidentiels d'un individu sp\u00e9cifique ou d'un groupe d'individus ayant un statut/une position plus \u00e9lev\u00e9s dans la soci\u00e9t\u00e9, un palais, par exemple."}
{"id": "2565c79d-1ee3-40ff-8ac6-d687896fe065", "value": "A preliminary excavation pit dug to determine the nature of a site and establish the techniques needed for actual excavation."}

{"id": "4a080192-cec1-4d23-8284-d72bd54a3604", "value": "Une fosse d'excavation pr\u00e9liminaire creus\u00e9e pour d\u00e9terminer la nature d'un site et \u00e9tablir les techniques n\u00e9cessaires \u00e0 l'excavation r\u00e9elle."}
{"id": "1a1bbf5b-4a2f-4c51-8b0a-5d441627d577", "value": "Structure in which multiple monument types are combined."}

{"id": "312c917d-4eea-49c6-840f-dfd2afd215b9", "value": "A structure projecting out into a body of water and used to protect a port/harbour and/or to dock, moor, load, and unload boats and ships, etc. Can be built on piles or fill"}
{"id": "c9bedab0-2633-4cf0-a457-417dd2632335", "value": "A structure or locale associated with production or processing of an unknown nature"}
{"id": "4ba024e4-6328-4460-9b42-e1828517fd7a", "value": "A fireplace for domestic cooking or metallurgical activities such as heating metals"}
{"id": "e57004ef-eecc-408a-930c-28b54d742d67", "value": "Un foyer destin\u00e9 \u00e0 la cuisine domestique ou \u00e0 des activit\u00e9s m\u00e9tallurgiques telles que le chauffage des m\u00e9taux."}

{"id": "96eaf68d-1270-44e2-b973-926538d58126", "value": "Large foss\u00e9 profond, sec ou rempli d'eau entourant un ch\u00e2teau, une fortification, un b\u00e2timent ou une ville, historiquement pour lui fournir une ligne de d\u00e9fense pr\u00e9liminaire."}

{"id": "bfe4893a-4572-47f1-a2af-92ed860107fd", "value": "A moat is a deep, broad ditch, either dry or filled with water, that is dug and surrounds a castle, fortification, building or town, historically to provide it with a preliminary line of defence."}
{"id": "12f3bb7b-2a5b-4a95-8b82-9d7ccab028e2", "value": "L'art grav\u00e9 sur la roche, c'est-\u00e0-dire la d\u00e9coupe ou la sculpture de la roche elle-m\u00eame pour cr\u00e9er des motifs."}
{"id": "5c78f5fc-8dcd-4a38-bbe8-6028ab681875", "value": "Art engraved onto rock, i.e. cutting or carving the rock itself to make designs"}

{"id": "89dfbeca-785a-46d9-8394-36eec06fa569", "value": "Les \u00e9coles enseignent le Coran et les sciences connexes en plus de l'arabe et des math\u00e9matiques. Le mot est d\u00e9riv\u00e9 d'une racine arabe qui indique la \"r\u00e9clusion dans la nature\", \u00e0 l'instar des moines chr\u00e9tiens. L'id\u00e9e est que les enseignants religieux cherchaient \u00e0 \u00eatre seuls pour poursuivre la m\u00e9ditation des mystiques. Ils s'isolaient dans une pi\u00e8ce semblable \u00e0 une cellule, dans une grotte ou m\u00eame \u00e0 l'int\u00e9rieur d'un baobab. Puis, comme l'enseignement du Coran et toute l'\u00e9ducation litt\u00e9raire ont \u00e9t\u00e9 associ\u00e9s aux fekki (cheikh) qui pratiquaient la r\u00e9clusion et l'asc\u00e9tisme de diverses mani\u00e8res, le mot khalwa en est venu \u00e0 d\u00e9signer l'\u00e9cole coranique (et une chambre pour les invit\u00e9s). La plupart des khalwas des p\u00e9riodes funj et turco-\u00e9gyptienne au Soudan appartenaient \u00e0 des individus ou \u00e0 des groupes familiaux qui se s\u00e9paraient de la lutte morale de la vie tribale et intertribale."}

{"id": "13ab987a-766f-4a49-884c-305f7e9baddf", "value": "Schools to teach Quran and related science in addition to Arabic and mathematics. The word is derived from an Arabic root indicating \u201cseclusion in the wild,\u201d much like Christian monks. The idea is that religious teachers sought to be alone in pursuit of mystics\u2019 meditation. They would isolate themselves in a cell-like room, a cave, or even inside a baobab tree. Then, as Quran teaching and all literary education became associated with the fekki (sheikh) who practiced seclusion and asceticism in various ways, the word khalwa came to mean the Quran School (and a room for guests). Most of the khalwas during the Funj and the Turko-Egyptian periods in Sudan belonged to individuals or family groups that separated themselves from the moral struggle of tribal and intertribal life."}

{"id": "5be97fe0-de5e-4260-8ebf-11cfcd9ffc8b", "value": "Cat\u00e9gorie : Terme\n D\u00e9finition : Moyen d'assurer la vie, notamment en obtenant de la nourriture. La subsistance est la partie de l'\u00e9conomie qui concerne l'acquisition, la distribution et la production de nourriture."}

{"id": "f0830281-ad94-40b5-834d-ba2c7435af69", "value": "Category: Term
 Definition: Means of supporting life, in particular by
 obtaining food. Subsistence is that part of economy concerned
 with acquisition, distribution, and production of food."}

{"id": "44e58601-6092-468e-b37a-f9b6eddccf5b", "value": "An artificially constructed water catchment basin with a circular earthen wall and diameters of between 70-250 m and heights of up to 7 m. Adapted to semi-desert conditions, the hafirs catch the water during the rainy season to have it available for several months during the dry season to supply drinking water, irrigate fields and water cattle. They have been used in central Sudan from time immemorial.\n Man-made depressions intended to catch and hold runoff wadis' water; for example Wadi es Sufra in the Butana. Hafirs are a common feature of the Keraba and Butana, the areas east and southeast of Meroe, and of the Sahel area of the Sudan, and are still being constructed and used extensively today."}

{"id": "5fdff3da-7201-47fd-9790-a83dbd0e2e36", "value": "Un bassin de captage d'eau construit artificiellement avec un mur de terre circulaire et des diam\u00e8tres compris entre 70-250 m et des hauteurs allant jusqu'\u00e0 7 m. Adapt\u00e9s aux conditions semi-d\u00e9sertiques, les hafirs captent l'eau pendant la saison des pluies pour en disposer pendant plusieurs mois pendant la saison s\u00e8che afin de fournir de l'eau potable, irriguer les champs et abreuver le b\u00e9tail. Ils sont utilis\u00e9s dans le centre du Soudan depuis des temps imm\u00e9moriaux."}
{"id": "82589a94-fcf7-4c2a-a22b-3efb22911d17", "value": "A large mound created from the continuous occupation or repeated abandonment/re-occupation of a specific locale"}
{"id": "cf6a1072-d762-43f4-be1e-947e18a2021d", "value": "Grand tertre ou amas artificiel de terre ou de pierres plus ou moins large \u00e9lev\u00e9 au-dessus d'une s\u00e9pulture."}
{"id": "a3191021-d803-48e3-b75f-6ce0a9713b3e", "value": "A large mound or artificial pile of earth or stones of varying widths raised above a grave."}
{"id": "b101cce6-3e41-4e43-a065-2cfa4d25dd15", "value": "It is a mound of earth and stones raised over a grave or graves"}
{"id": "388ade4f-8e9a-40ad-a80d-a8683c397a7a", "value": "Il s'agit d'un monticule de terre et de pierres \u00e9lev\u00e9 au-dessus d'une ou plusieurs tombes."}
{"id": "a6274f51-b292-430c-b85b-50cb035d62e1", "value": "The place of oaths and trials and some ceremonies are held here with no necessity of going further into the forest"}

{"id": "f9ef4968-10c6-4811-8719-22e3c71e1fdb", "value": "Any archaeological site that was primarily used for smelting iron from its ore in a furnace or the secondary process of smithing and forging tools. An iron smelting area can be recognized by its distinctive location (e.g. western side of an anthill, boulder or hill, particularly in East and southern Africa), metallurgical debris such as furnace rubble, tuyeres, anvil heads, slag and charcoal."}
{"id": "0f1330fa-714f-436f-9ece-9968abc964b2", "value": "Zone de production de fer/fourneaux"}
{"id": "8fd28e47-cf6b-4dc0-9c1d-c55260ae51da", "value": "Une zone au sol o\u00f9 les tessons de poterie sont dissimin\u00e9s sur la surface. La dispersion peut \u00eatre clairesem\u00e9e ou dense."}
{"id": "946a53e5-6ab1-491d-9910-18c73a47d253", "value": "An area of the ground where potsherds are spread over the surface; the scatter may be light or dense."}
{"id": "11225d23-799a-47b3-a793-e22ff2aaaf0c", "value": "Track or series of metals rails along which a train runs"}

{"id": "cebecbae-29ab-4cdc-a4ba-2fe0d894f9c3", "value": "A non-specific term referring to any building.\n Non specific catch-all for sites mentioning multiple structures but not noting their individual locations"}

{"id": "4bd9e512-f5bb-4541-9183-cf5c283bc2ea", "value": "Terme non sp\u00e9cifique d\u00e9signant tout b\u00e2timent.\n Fourre-tout non sp\u00e9cifique pour les sites mentionnant plusieurs structures mais ne pr\u00e9cisant pas leurs emplacements individuels."}
{"id": "d7eaef90-a37f-4719-a4f9-c09d4c7182cd", "value": "An archaeological site or part thereof which is managed by an authorised body"}

{"id": "7462fd89-a46d-4654-90f0-b66ca10e2804", "value": "Vestiges d'une structure physique (b\u00e2timent, mur, etc.) trouv\u00e9s partiellement ou totalement expos\u00e9s. Ils peuvent \u00eatre enti\u00e8rement ou partiellement en ruine, mais ne doivent pas \u00eatre dans un \u00e9tat pratiquement inchang\u00e9."}

{"id": "2c084252-93ac-4dfd-b488-2408c645b72b", "value": "Remains of a physical structure (building, wall, etc) found either partly or fully exposed. May be entirely or partially ruined, but should not be in a mostly unaltered state."}
{"id": "157f967b-f700-4655-8bb2-4b003c847126", "value": "The official state house and is used to house all secret objects of\n the community."}
{"id": "4a5dbdc2-cbb8-4084-8a89-a2d86cbfb805", "value": "Un mur qui d\u00e9finit les limites des colonies de peuplement, peut aussi \u00eatre pour des raisons de s\u00e9curit\u00e9."}
{"id": "02636375-256f-46ae-9d7e-e68cece930e6", "value": "A wall that defines the boundaries of settlements, may also be for security reasons."}

{"id": "f636147a-b1d8-4dac-afee-1bc1e990eea2", "value": "Un type de maison fortifi\u00e9e, reconnu comme un \u00e9l\u00e9ment distinctif du paysage de la Nubie moyenne, qui se trouve principalement dans les zones situ\u00e9es au sud du Batn al-Hajar. Certaines ont clairement la capacit\u00e9 de servir \u00e0 des fins d\u00e9fensives, mais elles pr\u00e9sentent \u00e9galement une grande vari\u00e9t\u00e9 de formes et de techniques de construction."}

{"id": "6a236380-2d90-4644-97f1-27c90f134998", "value": "A type of fortified house, recognised as a distinctive feature of the Middle Nubian landscape occurring mainly in areas south of the Batn al-Hajar. Some clearly have the capability of serving defensive purposes, but they also show considerable variety in form and construction techniques."}
{"id": "a69945bc-6125-4314-aa5f-de23f8749256", "value": "Burial inside hollow boulder sealed by rock wall or cairn."}
{"id": "598582c8-a8c7-437c-bb64-bf37d5b60d38", "value": "Paved area from which extend paved extensions; tumulus near centre."}
{"id": "da5faaca-3f6b-483b-9e76-99d903984e2f", "value": "A pile of stones created through the clearing of land, most often for agricultural purposes"}
{"id": "b5580fb4-cb88-4ef2-aa3d-8c2ed961ad1f", "value": "Space set up for divine worship"}
{"id": "b0418b99-ed64-4810-93a4-e5c4db9c25b0", "value": "Espace am\u00e9nag\u00e9 pour des cultes divins"}
{"id": "a06fc817-9b82-474f-b169-cf00514230f9", "value": "Any earthern banks, ditches, stone walling or fencing used to demarcate or show the boundary of a certain space"}
{"id": "8d174374-dc64-4773-8c3b-ed5100c8d800", "value": "tout talus de terre, foss\u00e9, mur de pierre ou cl\u00f4ture utilis\u00e9 pour d\u00e9limiter ou montrer la limite d'un certain espace"}
{"id": "c4a50399-900f-4ac9-bdfd-86548e1090b4", "value": "A collection of artefacts that can be directly associated with a burial"}
{"id": "f7ee3f1c-b64b-49b1-a95b-fccdd76d8151", "value": "Une collection d'artefacts qui peuvent \u00eatre directement associ\u00e9s \u00e0 une s\u00e9pulture."}

{"id": "5c651299-0c1d-4a63-985d-e5828c6c0247", "value": "Un lieu o\u00f9 les gens vivent dans le pass\u00e9 ou le pr\u00e9sent. G\u00e9n\u00e9ralement form\u00e9 d'un groupe de maisons et d'autres b\u00e2timents."}
{"id": "37472a50-b5dd-4e58-990d-97cf98d64892", "value": "A place where people live in the past or present. Usually formed of a group of houses and other buildings"}

{"id": "dcbd64b5-56cb-4644-8ea2-1e578d6c6142", "value": "A Roman building used as a courthouse or for other official, public activities or events, usually with one apsed end. Not to be used for churches"}
{"id": "48821749-14d5-4a61-8df4-3385ca21083e", "value": "A purpose built facility for the mass storage of a product i.e. Warehouses, Granaries."}
{"id": "abdbac1f-1f9d-470b-9c35-43e13055cc66", "value": "A building intended for human habitation"}
{"id": "3d18a103-ec62-4627-8537-1597c8309ce3", "value": "Un b\u00e2timent destin\u00e9 \u00e0 l'habitation humaine"}

{"id": "3af24ae3-fc5a-44c0-8a10-39b9f92dc38c", "value": "There exist many monuments with \u00abarms\u00bb, representing intermediate forms between V-shapes, heel-shaped cairns, and crescents generally."}
{"id": "2ecd833e-128c-4741-9ed9-68fd2259874f", "value": "Upright pillar, can be freestanding, or used as support features in a building"}

{"id": "8114789c-1fbd-495c-9109-4eafcddb7082", "value": "L'autel est un espace sacr\u00e9 ou saint d\u00e9di\u00e9 \u00e0 une divinit\u00e9, un anc\u00eatre, un h\u00e9ros, un martyr, un saint, un d\u00e9mon ou une figure de respect similaire, dans lequel ils sont v\u00e9n\u00e9r\u00e9s ou ador\u00e9s. Les sanctuaires contiennent souvent des idoles, des reliques ou d'autres objets similaires associ\u00e9s \u00e0 la figure v\u00e9n\u00e9r\u00e9e."}

{"id": "b96807f2-7dcb-4d81-9a8f-fb9ea2fd620d", "value": "A shrine is a sacred or holy space dedicated to a deity, ancestor, hero, martyr, saint, demon or similar figure of respect, in which they are venerated or worshiped. Shrines often contain idols, relics or other similar objects associated with the revered figure."}
{"id": "93fd5df3-2845-43fe-a9ce-46d8cb5a44fe", "value": "Kipfer, Barbara Ann. Encyclopedic dictionary of archaeology. Cham: Springer International Publishing, 2021"}
{"id": "38972840-1823-4c41-bc43-95549b837799", "value": "The place on a core or flake where it was struck by a hammer."}
{"id": "64b05423-4a3c-4e4f-87f4-815688196269", "value": "A tract of land used for burials"}
{"id": "f7b9f6cf-6bea-4c6f-adc5-1edb5383e044", "value": "Une parcelle de terrain utilis\u00e9e pour les enterrements"}
{"id": "4e85bdbf-5bed-4d1e-9248-eed1bd538497", "value": "Kenya occidental"}

{"id": "23593b2a-79b0-4122-b2c1-94e671c6e721", "value": "Gunda-buche are either single or multiple ditch-and-bank earthworks which once fortified or enclosed settlement structures found in western Kenya, Lake Victoria Basin. Archaeologists currently associate gunde-buche earthworks with Luo settlements in pre-colonial times."}

{"id": "6f3abfe8-d230-40de-ae4d-71fe9f348ce4", "value": "Un mur ou une clôture continue de pieux, spécialement
 pour la défense ; une série de longs pieux solides, pointus au sommet et rapprochés les uns des autres comme moyen de défense. Ils étaient généralement placés dans
 une tranchée de fondation continue ou au sommet de vallums,
 des talus ou des remparts entourant un fort."}

{"id": "b075a085-7b87-4ea1-b33e-946827393fcb", "value": "A continuous wall or fence of stakes, especially
 for defense; a series of long strong stakes pointed at the top and set close with others as a defense. They were usually set in
 a continuous foundation trench or on the tops of vallums,
 embankments, or ramparts surrounding a fort."}
{"id": "6208ae29-628e-4f2d-a633-d16368a627c4", "value": "a place of residence or habitation consisting of wall structures constructed using stone without the use of mortar or cement."}

{"id": "f447e8c1-a4a0-4db6-aa84-b51c3f8eb907", "value": "un lieu de r\u00e9sidence ou d'habitation constitu\u00e9 de structures murales construites en pierre sans utilisation de mortier ou de ciment."}
{"id": "625b5e1e-8203-4a9e-9ead-5dba4e8196de", "value": "Murets construits dans les zones de montagne utilis\u00e9es pour l'agriculture"}
{"id": "c0cea297-7f1d-40a4-83a1-bc081731b1df", "value": "Walling constructed in mountains areas that are used for agriculture"}

{"id": "db6958cd-9a3a-4591-aa60-a7e692c3a90d", "value": "Une cascade d'eau tombant d'une hauteur, form\u00e9e lorsqu'une rivi\u00e8re ou un ruisseau coule sur un pr\u00e9cipice ou une pente raide. Peut faire partie du patrimoine immat\u00e9riel et du site du patrimoine naturel."}

{"id": "a79e0446-9631-46e5-8705-51948e8c84b0", "value": "A cascade of water falling from a height, formed when a river or stream flows over a precipice or steep incline. Can be part of intangible heritage and natural heritage site."}
{"id": "45637f55-3a4a-40f0-9b47-3fee33cf6ea4", "value": "El\u00e9vation de terrain naturelle ou artificielle o\u00f9 se sont install\u00e9s les hommes."}
{"id": "ebdd7a62-b4d1-45bd-a3b1-02b7189f628c", "value": "Natural or artificial elevation where people have settled."}
{"id": "252df1d2-a3b1-4016-920f-d02fbfa6a69a", "value": "A structure or locale associated with the production or processing of animals/animal products, e.g. butchers, tannery, fullonica"}
{"id": "26c0303b-1b6f-4e82-bc3b-4d71a8e2e4d3", "value": "A generic term referring to an unknown structure built of stone"}
{"id": "2d1139cb-2f13-43c2-a328-669717736c8d", "value": "Terme g\u00e9n\u00e9rique d\u00e9signant une structure inconnue construite en pierre."}

{"id": "90d00536-21be-4021-aa75-7073a59a2944", "value": "All structures and activities that are associated with the production, transport or storage of products utilised for sustenance for both human and animal"}

{"id": "dbd0e710-ee25-4101-a047-8827ffdc47b5", "value": "Toutes les structures et activit\u00e9s associ\u00e9es \u00e0 la production, au transport ou au stockage de produits utilis\u00e9s pour l'alimentation humaine et animale."}
{"id": "8dcd358b-5513-4c42-a6c4-e25ec1a4b5d5", "value": "Tumulus with a top that has mostly-horizonal profile. Gentle concave exedra is characteristic of the front face."}
{"id": "4a6ff505-949b-43df-99a1-0cdf255a6cfb", "value": "Un monument comm\u00e9moratif"}
{"id": "14c165dc-bf5e-4b1f-99b4-eb217189fdec", "value": "A commemoration monument."}
{"id": "31499419-2143-4d79-831a-ca8ca12a1f73", "value": "Type de tombe en d\u00f4me sp\u00e9cifique au monde islamique"}
{"id": "d5ba147d-3e9f-401d-8841-452ac0e127af", "value": "Specific type of Islamic domed tomb"}

{"id": "b057e2b9-62da-445e-a711-8a953c45f878", "value": "An area of land, associated buildings and features which is specifically allocated for the use of agriculture/arboriculture/animal rearing. This resource interpretation refers to the entire farm complex, rather than any individual farm buildings."}
{"id": "2b46e54f-ec09-4a63-bb04-2929b9790bae", "value": "une petite \u00e9tendue d'eau calme et peu profonde, g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement form\u00e9e de fa\u00e7on naturelle."}
{"id": "cc491edb-a362-4f6f-b6df-c95aac60fb6e", "value": "a small and shallow body of still water usually formed naturally"}
{"id": "5cee70d9-c7ff-4f38-ab78-003cccd1f90d", "value": "bouses de b\u00e9tail/restes f\u00e9caux d'animaux g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement d\u00e9couverts lors de fouilles de couches culturelles."}
{"id": "c6e79c3e-a2fc-40bc-9641-aa2dcb810b12", "value": "livestock dung/animal faecal remains usually found during excavations of cultural layers"}
{"id": "21191670-c3e9-4425-8863-f10969fad723", "value": "This site exists within a cave - i.e., a natural opening into the ground/a cliffside etc."}
{"id": "6aefc279-dd73-4dd0-815b-974366753c7d", "value": "Ce site se trouve dans une grotte, c'est-\u00e0-dire une ouverture naturelle dans le sol, \u00e0 flanc de falaise, etc."}
{"id": "c6e34969-b6cd-41b1-885a-af295eeab67e", "value": "Contructions constitu\u00e9es de longs murs de pierres s\u00e8ches convergeant vers un col, utilis\u00e9es pour le pi\u00e9geage du gibier."}
{"id": "6b609624-96ef-4788-8d8e-a4287a8e0a26", "value": "Contructions consisting of long dry-stone walls converging on a neck used for trapping game."}
{"id": "68d65857-7f93-4b1c-8e76-c369b588bfb8", "value": "Place in the earth that is excavated to extract minerals or precious stones"}
{"id": "d25b6b5f-3c76-434c-aff0-df3b436af828", "value": "Endroit dans la terre qui est excav\u00e9 pour extraire des min\u00e9raux ou des pierres pr\u00e9cieuses."}
{"id": "25654518-00a3-4d3d-9dfe-c2d6d922b8f1", "value": "Une r\u00e9sidence d'\u00e9lite fortifi\u00e9e"}
{"id": "1035ca6d-b1a3-4ad9-b566-413af6e5c9b4", "value": "A fortified elite residence"}
{"id": "9662c601-1ca3-4cc3-9b3b-30f9f63e2950", "value": "Espace de v\u00e9n\u00e9ration de divinit\u00e9, de personnage, d\u2019objet ou de chose consid\u00e9r\u00e9s comme sacr\u00e9s."}
{"id": "2a647e97-6348-489a-bd9c-e4be8541e4b3", "value": "Space for the veneration of a deity, person, object or thing considered as sacred."}
{"id": "046924d7-0d50-4578-bc72-569e12345578", "value": "A large mass of rock/aggregation of rocks which can provide temporary shelter"}
{"id": "9579bffc-c32d-408a-87d0-ca4b0636ce6a", "value": "Une grande masse de roches/un agr\u00e9gat de roches qui peut fournir un abri temporaire."}
{"id": "7ea31059-ad6a-41f6-a56c-f20853ea4ff8", "value": "Surface de terrain sur\u00e9lev\u00e9e cr\u00e9\u00e9e artificiellement sur laquelle est \u00e9rig\u00e9e une hutte/ un logement."}
{"id": "cbd714ec-e9d7-4b03-8f90-2e58430201d7", "value": "Artificially created raised ground surface on which a hut/dwelling is erected"}
{"id": "12a3e911-b952-4644-95f5-2b9c0ae0b855", "value": "Constructed or rock-cut pond or reservoir used to stock fish for aquaculture"}

{"id": "a4d886ad-987e-4bed-a761-f5de08416661", "value": "Similar to other pit structures, however, they are located on lower elevations and gentler slopes with the outer walling being significantly lower"}

{"id": "73202ff0-ca2c-45d2-b512-8b1fa642b1dd", "value": "Comme les autres structures de fosse, elles sont cependant situ\u00e9es \u00e0 des altitudes plus basses et sur des pentes plus douces, les murs ext\u00e9rieurs \u00e9tant nettement plus bas."}

{"id": "ae4869d5-d1e7-4f35-9d43-4e47b75bed5f", "value": "Il s'agit d'un type de tombe monumentale dont l'\u00e9l\u00e9ment central est un unique pilier pro\u00e9minent ou une colonne, souvent en pierre."}
{"id": "718d8cb4-6aba-475c-9ce1-7578aa357455", "value": "This is a type of monumental grave wherein the central feature is a single, prominent pillar or column, often made of stone"}
{"id": "9bd55a35-8948-4e14-aaf9-94d23e412da2", "value": "Une structure destin\u00e9e \u00e0 \u00eatre habit\u00e9e par des soldats."}
{"id": "fe8196cc-cd72-48de-8272-deec8ddb18db", "value": "A structure intended for soldiers to inhabit"}
{"id": "eb449410-4ac1-4beb-b830-87b000f5d59c", "value": "Tumulus from which extend paved arms of uniform width, similar to V-type but with elongated rather than round tumulus."}
{"id": "0b39f476-c5b3-4c8e-96c3-e1dcafbb7bbc", "value": "Circumscribed place where miscellaneous or waste objects are deposited."}
{"id": "734adc1a-0517-4463-8666-5efbe72f0408", "value": "Endroit circonscrit o\u00f9 sont d\u00e9pos\u00e9s des objets h\u00e9t\u00e9roclites ou de rebut."}
{"id": "69f0021c-54b4-4b33-a979-2f6014ee05c2", "value": "A structure or building used for grinding/milling and fueled by water"}
{"id": "ed38218f-cfc5-4863-a2b1-ab42c0ee6b3b", "value": "Structure designed for the processing/manufacture of pottery, lime or metal"}

{"id": "ebc1302b-1849-4eb6-94ac-f3e13f09fec1", "value": "fait g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement r\u00e9f\u00e9rence aux restes d'excr\u00e9ments trouv\u00e9s l\u00e0 o\u00f9 les animaux domestiques \u00e9taient gard\u00e9s ou enferm\u00e9s."}
{"id": "e9734bd5-9324-4507-bc9e-437c292ed134", "value": "usually refers to dung remains found where domesticated animals were kept or penned"}

{"id": "e9bf852d-ed5e-4dcc-ac94-786b305677ff", "value": "Une zone constitu\u00e9e de mat\u00e9riaux en pierre taill\u00e9e. La taille comprend le processus de travail du silex ou de la pierre par percussion (directe ou indirecte) ou par pression.\n Utilis\u00e9 sp\u00e9cifiquement pour produire des outils lithiques."}

{"id": "31d40e23-b40a-4be1-a610-20b44ee6553e", "value": "An area consisting of knapped stone materials. Knapping includes the process of working flint or stone either by percussion (direct or indirect) or by pressure.\n Used specifically to produce lithic tools."}

{"id": "60aa8218-a8f4-4012-9411-de952bbe3601", "value": "A natural shelter formed from under an overhang or between outcrops of rock - often used as shelter by historic and prehistoric peoples;\n Habitat (or other?) in a lower part of an escarpment protected by a ledge."}

{"id": "90832f04-ef59-44ae-8f2c-3030f8fb887d", "value": "Un abri naturel form\u00e9 sous un surplomb ou entre des affleurements rocheux - souvent utilis\u00e9 comme abri par les peuples historiques et pr\u00e9historiques.\n Habitat (ou autre ?) dans une partie inf\u00e9rieure d'un escarpement prot\u00e9g\u00e9e par une corniche."}
{"id": "fcc93aa7-b559-4332-8052-4194ac015c4d", "value": "These are megalithic monuments whose burial structures are marked out with stone blocks."}
{"id": "37ad61db-f149-4b10-a104-5b65cca0f305", "value": "Il s\u2019agit de monuments m\u00e9galithiques dont les structures fun\u00e9raires sont d\u00e9limit\u00e9es avec des blocs de pierre."}

{"id": "6976089f-35ed-4cb7-9f44-fbcd0518788f", "value": "A low wall or arrangement of stones (often surrounding a cleared area), used to weigh down/support the edges of a tent (or other temporary structure)"}
{"id": "294b4357-1a58-4a77-bb00-50ebefcd6a93", "value": "A structure, building, or other locale designed to hold or house human (or animal) remains"}

{"id": "291b713e-d00e-4d9a-a239-a5775605a611", "value": "Place of production.\n These are well-appointed spaces that are designed for specialised activities such as stone cutting, iron reduction or forging."}

{"id": "2d773f77-9ddb-436c-9d6f-4a2c08e91d5a", "value": "Lieu de production.\n Il s\u2019agit d\u2019espaces bien am\u00e9nag\u00e9s qui sont pr\u00e9vus pour des activit\u00e9s sp\u00e9cialis\u00e9es comme la taille des pi\u00e8ces lithiques, la r\u00e9duction du fer ou le forgeage."}
skos:Concept.skos:prefLabel: {"id": "28e1c9f0-d2f7-477a-ac9b-37943abf0a86", "value": "Atelier\n Atelier (de taille, de r\u00e9ducion ou de forge) (Ad)"}

skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "a07be33e-8ddd-4151-a412-89af447dd7b1", "value": "Utilis\u00e9 \u00e0 des fins militaires, principalement pour se d\u00e9fendre contre des menaces ext\u00e9rieures, par exemple, des murs ou autres fortifications."}
{"id": "91b69138-3c07-40e9-91b1-cc055150f7d1", "value": "Used for military purposes, primarily to defend from external threats - for example, walls or other fortifications."}
{"id": "7eaa8b35-4de3-496f-935b-b6418d9fd3a4", "value": "any area of land separated from surrounding land by stone walling or fencing"}
{"id": "b217c853-14e5-42e0-82bc-fb58134b4089", "value": "Toute zone de terrain s\u00e9par\u00e9e des terrains environnants par un mur de pierre ou une cl\u00f4ture."}
{"id": "7f5629e9-22e4-44fb-aff0-e605c3c1d327", "value": "An area of ground in which deceased individuals are buried"}
{"id": "439f00e9-d77d-4872-a106-005c776a3912", "value": "Une zone de terrain dans laquelle les personnes d\u00e9c\u00e9d\u00e9es sont enterr\u00e9es."}
{"id": "93a459a6-a760-4b23-91d4-e60fb2e7e5b3", "value": "An open-air area entirely enclosed by walls or buildings, sometimes distinguished from more private courtyards"}
{"id": "7b2c5afc-7211-43d1-b8e5-73e9ab5f3768", "value": "Un espace en plein air enti\u00e8rement clos par des murs ou des b\u00e2timents, parfois distingu\u00e9 des cours plus priv\u00e9es."}

{"id": "b72c3b72-fbc3-4841-b98a-8097ba889dd6", "value": "A singular enclosure at a much larger scale than seen in most places. In the west of Mali, and particularly within the Tessalit region, enclosures are seen on a particularly large scale (\u22641.5 ha), perhaps serving as venues for ceremonial gatherings and seasonally housing entire communities. May be fortified with ring ditches, and/or reinforced with acacia abatis."}
{"id": "9f016aea-f3ea-4b19-887b-76f780b4284a", "value": "A river is an overland flow of liquid water between a source and a mouth or confluence with a modulus flow greater than zero."}

{"id": "e824ec9b-3000-414e-8bb3-eef2ee609c23", "value": "Un cours d'eau est un \u00e9coulement terrestre d'eau liquide entre une source et une embouchure ou une confluence avec un d\u00e9bit \u00e0 module sup\u00e9rieur \u00e0 z\u00e9ro."}

{"id": "fabd0fa4-3a89-4a62-a75c-fc26af9087a2", "value": "Cours d'eau le plus souvent intermittent des r\u00e9gions s\u00e8ches, o\u00f9 l'alimentation s'effectue presque uniquement par ruissellement, et s'achevant g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement dans une d\u00e9pression ferm\u00e9e ou disparaissant par \u00e9puisement. (https://www.larousse.fr/dictionnaires/francais/oued/56870)"}

{"id": "ea6e7abf-c0e1-4de1-9040-ddce3925c3d1", "value": "Mostly intermittent watercourse in dry regions, fed almost entirely by runoff, and usually ending in a closed depression or disappearing by exhaustion. (translation of https://www.larousse.fr/dictionnaires/francais/oued/56870)"}
{"id": "0b6f0075-3709-40ba-ae07-3ac00c90e15a", "value": "Fossilized faeces of animals"}
{"id": "538265d7-bdff-4a9d-bcf2-0b244364387a", "value": "F\u00e8ces fossilis\u00e9es d'animaux"}
{"id": "0d174469-abe0-45db-a79f-0fd3062731f8", "value": "Les \u00e9glises aksumites d'Ethiopie sont souvent qualifi\u00e9es de m\u00e9ga-\u00e9glises."}
{"id": "5aecf3e0-94e1-427b-b8c1-458a5ba4cca1", "value": "Ethiopia Aksumite churches are often refered to as megachurches"}
{"id": "fbfb205c-dd2f-46a1-a26c-0f4cd5228960", "value": "Li\u00e9s \u00e0 la production d'articles en m\u00e9tal, plus particuli\u00e8rement."}
{"id": "6db191d3-d8ab-4fe5-aba0-9993c5bdebeb", "value": "Related to the production of metal items more specifically."}
{"id": "e2fcc29b-1bbb-480d-a53d-d9c4b3af1e10", "value": "A street or road which has been monumentalised by the addition of columns that run for all or part of its length."}

{"id": "071b1303-e2e2-4317-b828-a2b9d3815eff", "value": "The Ancestral Hall is a building associated with veneration of ancestors. They exist to serve as a place where the living might demonstrate their respect and honor for the previous generations in their lineage, and to conduct important familial ceremonies, such as marriage and funerals. As the seat of a lineage, they serve as an important locus in the identity of a family. This grounding of identity is a source of strength for these people, making them feel like part of an unbroken chain of human effort and achievement."}

{"id": "c38fcbc6-f274-4460-a69e-b56f21e4001c", "value": "La salle des anc\u00eatres est un b\u00e2timent associ\u00e9 \u00e0 la v\u00e9n\u00e9ration des anc\u00eatres. Elle sert de lieu o\u00f9 les vivants peuvent recueillir et manifester leur respect envers leurs anc\u00eatres et o\u00f9 se d\u00e9roulent les c\u00e9r\u00e9monies familiales importantes, comme les mariages et les fun\u00e9railles. En tant que si\u00e8ge d'une lign\u00e9e, ils constituent un lieu important de l'identit\u00e9 d'une famille. Cet ancrage identitaire est une source de force pour ces personnes, qui ont le sentiment de faire partie d'une cha\u00eene ininterrompue d'efforts et de r\u00e9alisations."}

{"id": "8af60827-99a1-4da7-af95-5daf424d1c6c", "value": "Un rampart est une longueur de berge ou de mur faisant partie de la limite d\u00e9fensive d'un ch\u00e2teau, d'une forteresse ou d'un autre site fortifi\u00e9."}
{"id": "5d48512d-385c-4457-a233-ccd7b1d52d19", "value": "A rampart is a length of bank or wall forming part of the defensive boundary of a castle, hillfort, settlement or other fortified site"}
{"id": "7b527796-413d-49a8-8217-70b7dbce8078", "value": "Used specifically for the placement of an individual or individuals (or the remains of their body or bodies) into the ground."}

{"id": "dc3c68ff-3466-4685-a804-179ebbe09c62", "value": "Une zone de terrain dans laquelle les personnes d\u00e9c\u00e9d\u00e9es sont enterr\u00e9es.\n Utilis\u00e9 sp\u00e9cifiquement pour la mise en terre d'un ou plusieurs individus (ou des restes de leur(s) corps)."}
{"id": "c380c9a6-ef92-44c5-a398-519f48642bd2", "value": "toute structure en pierre ou tout monticule de terre destin\u00e9 \u00e0 soutenir une structure, par exemple une tr\u00e9mie \u00e0 grains."}
{"id": "1e0e8cd1-d976-4f5f-8716-c7ac8ac3a36d", "value": "any stone structure or earthwork mound intended to support a structure i.e grain bin"}
{"id": "0853fa69-3a3a-471d-8996-a806685acccd", "value": "Any watercraft built or fitted out to engage in acts of war"}
{"id": "d7c9eddc-1419-419e-8775-9a0818da0592", "value": "A chamber that is used as a grave"}
{"id": "b11f14b3-c3d1-4422-afd4-c8b6018634b4", "value": "Une chambre qui est utilis\u00e9e comme une tombe"}

{"id": "d9fa17f6-3067-411d-9f34-c5a0979add7f", "value": "Un foss\u00e9 long et \u00e9troit. Particuli\u00e8rement utilis\u00e9 pour d\u00e9signer les tranch\u00e9es utilis\u00e9es dans les fouilles arch\u00e9ologiques."}
{"id": "e2c530a2-d1d7-45f4-89d2-8f7d4f5dc722", "value": "A long, narrow ditch. Especially used to refer to trenches used in archaeological excavation"}
{"id": "3982ebfd-f7a3-4c6e-a90d-757a651c44c5", "value": "Same as death pits, used for the hunting of large game"}
{"id": "ce0be104-cf17-4c31-82be-3c012d7809b0", "value": "Identique aux fosses de la mort (trou de loup), utilis\u00e9es pour la chasse au gros gibier"}

{"id": "0ecf7262-c813-451e-bfc2-5954b7bb6e3f", "value": "Wooden, brick (including a mixture of daga and mud), or stone\u2010built structure used for storing grain or other crops. Granaries can also be built on stilts or legs of some kind to raise it off the ground also known as a raised Granary. This allows the grain to be kept drier through the circulation of air below the floor and to be better protected from vermin."}

{"id": "c8fcf408-d0f8-4890-9262-8dfce6a3c7ea", "value": "Structure en bois, en briques (y compris un m\u00e9lange de daga et de boue) ou en pierre utilis\u00e9e pour stocker le grain ou d'autres r\u00e9coltes. Les greniers peuvent \u00e9galement \u00eatre construits sur des pilotis ou des pieds pour les \u00e9lever au-dessus du sol (grenier sur\u00e9lev\u00e9). Cela permet au grain de rester plus sec gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 la circulation d'air sous le sol et d'\u00eatre mieux prot\u00e9g\u00e9 de la vermine."}
{"id": "c4281a64-2b1b-4561-bc0e-9da6616654a6", "value": "A site the entirety of which was uncovered through excavation, and none of which is extant above ground, even in a ruined state."}

{"id": "c665a134-f250-4557-9572-07132e3f503b", "value": "Un site dont la totalit\u00e9 a \u00e9t\u00e9 mise au jour par des fouilles, et dont aucune partie n'existe en surface, m\u00eame \u00e0 l'\u00e9tat de ruine."}
{"id": "6954f082-582e-464f-8403-70206dc9cd20", "value": "A place where miscellaneous or heterogeneous objects are scattered."}
{"id": "8bc991ab-fd4a-45b3-8515-79636f9c426c", "value": "Endroit o\u00f9 sont \u00e9parpill\u00e9s des objets h\u00e9t\u00e9roclites ou de rebut."}

{"id": "99343fa0-f09c-46b1-ac53-aaf4dbd74631", "value": "Une fosse remplie de pointes utilis\u00e9e pour la chasse au gros gibier.Une zone (trou, puits, cavit\u00e9) creus\u00e9e par l'homme pour pi\u00e9ger les animaux. Ces fosses, qui peuvent mesurer jusqu'\u00e0 4 m\u00e8tres sur 7 et \u00eatre profondes de plusieurs m\u00e8tres, \u00e9taient camoufl\u00e9es par des branches et des feuilles. Elles avaient des parois abruptes garnies de planches ou de ma\u00e7onnerie, ce qui rendait impossible la fuite de l'animal une fois tomb\u00e9 dedans. Lorsque l'animal \u00e9tait tomb\u00e9 dans la fosse, il \u00e9tait tu\u00e9, soit saign\u00e9 \u00e0 mort par des b\u00e2tons point\u00e9s vers le haut depuis le fond de la fosse, soit, dans le cas de fosses d\u00e9pourvues de ces b\u00e2tons, distribu\u00e9s par des chasseurs attendant \u00e0 proximit\u00e9."}

{"id": "4e3c8632-3212-468c-acd7-949eabc0db0d", "value": "An area (hole, shaft, cavity) dug out by humans to trap animals. These pits, which can measure up to 4 by 7 metres (13 ft \u00d7 23 ft) in size and be up to several metres deep, were camouflaged with branches and leaves. They had steep sides lined with planks or masonry, making it impossible for the animal to escape once it had fallen in. When the animal had fallen into the pit, it was killed, either bled to death by sharpened sticks pointed upwards from the bottom of the pit, or in the case of pits without these sticks, dispatched by hunters waiting nearby."}

{"id": "e07c15c3-d3f4-4ff3-9402-72b05dff34ac", "value": "Megalithic sites are necropolises that often appear as complexes of several funerary monuments, generally structured by stone blocks or by tumuli associated with frontal stones."}

{"id": "69981ba5-2f27-48d4-a225-5380ee1cabfd", "value": "Les sites m\u00e9galithiques sont des n\u00e9cropoles qui se pr\u00e9sentent souvent comme des complexes de plusieurs monuments fun\u00e9raires, structur\u00e9s g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement par des blocs de pierre ou par des tumuli associ\u00e9s avec des pierres frontales."}

{"id": "38ae0328-3f57-43ac-a382-b153d7ed54c9", "value": "A defined place where people periodically gather together at\n predetermined times for the purchase and sale of goods, livestock, services,\n or commodities of various kinds within the structure of a market economy."}

{"id": "e266c0f3-d78a-484d-9bd0-5f7b09cf1418", "value": "Un lieu d\u00e9fini o\u00f9 les gens se rassemblent p\u00e9riodiquement \u00e0 des moments pr\u00e9d\u00e9termin\u00e9s pour l'achat et la vente de biens, de b\u00e9tail, de services, ou de marchandises de toutes sortes dans le cadre d'une \u00e9conomie de march\u00e9."}
{"id": "95283952-8f60-4715-8212-03331c8bbe4d", "value": "A structure with walls and a roof enclosing an area, but for which no specific purpose can definitely be identified"}
{"id": "355afdc7-4a6d-4f94-814d-aa4d2855daed", "value": "Monument whose principal apparent feature is a line of vertical fl at stones, typically pointed to give tooth-like appearance"}
{"id": "2cc15108-20a4-4135-be23-c9ccfacf18db", "value": "A 3-dimensional artistic depiction of a person, animal, or object"}

{"id": "003ffa91-56a5-4945-a000-4f4b96e42a0c", "value": "Conteneur, autrefois en bois ou en brique, mais plus souvent aujourd'hui en m\u00e9tal ou en b\u00e9ton, qui entoure un cercueil pour \u00e9viter que la tombe ne s'enfonce."}

{"id": "ed7e9803-c8fb-46c1-a449-941abd8c5281", "value": "A container, formerly made of wood or brick but more often today made of metal or concrete, that encloses a coffin to help prevent a grave from sinking"}
{"id": "97824359-0a77-4ba6-ad3b-e26b030a488c", "value": "Any watercraft whose main propulsion is by engine rather than sail. Includes all engine types including steam, petrol and diesel"}

{"id": "b0a6539d-2195-4ede-85e5-e58a1fd23016", "value": "Les cupules rocheuses sont des d\u00e9pressions artificielles sur des surfaces rocheuses qui ressemblent \u00e0 la forme d'une calotte ou d'un d\u00f4me sph\u00e9rique invers\u00e9. Elles ont \u00e9t\u00e9 r\u00e9alis\u00e9es par percussion directe avec des marteaux de pierre tenus \u00e0 la main, sur des surfaces rocheuses verticales, inclin\u00e9es ou horizontales."}

{"id": "ee48a4e6-56c5-424a-9541-2a3ffb89bbde", "value": "Rock cupules are circular man-made hollows on the surface of a rock or a rock slab, believed to be the earliest prehistoric rock art and were produced to recent times."}
{"id": "9a9a08f9-ed52-4ff4-b4d1-69d89314d64f", "value": "Il s'agit d'un canal creus\u00e9 lors de la construction d'une digue."}
{"id": "d1c43510-286d-4063-beb1-7bb84c1fd784", "value": "This refers to a channel dug in the process of constructing an embankment"}

{"id": "23b957fd-7d9b-4f15-a803-293208d85f14", "value": "The direct process of iron-making is a technique of smelting iron ore in a furnace with charcoal and limestone to produce a spongy, low-carbon form of iron known as a bloom. This ductile material can be forged into tools and weapons. The indrect process of iron-making is a technique of smelting iron ore in a furnace at a very high temperature to yield a molten, high-carbon form of iron. The high-carbon content makes it too brittle for most direct uses, so it must undergo a secondary process, oxidization, to make it more ductile. It can then be forged into weapons and tools. The indirect process of iron-making was developed in China early in the first millennium BC. The Chinese made iron artifacts, heating blooms in a fire and hammering the red-hot metal to produce the desired objects; iron made in this way is known as wrought iron."}
{"id": "d862c72a-bf6a-4c54-8030-63f710a1113f", "value": "A collection of items that appear to have been intentionally hidden"}
{"id": "53018f36-6011-4f47-99e3-243f3d4dab5e", "value": "A collection of items that appear to have been intentionally hidden.\n Lieu ?"}

{"id": "73f25f00-2df7-4833-90de-0ae447facdc4", "value": "In Type 2 goulets, the enclosures generally are more circular, without the narrowing at one end as in a Type 1 goulet (Plate 7b). In contrast with a Type 1 goulet, in which the tumulus (if present) is adjacent to the perimeter of the monument at its narrower end, in Type 2 goulets the tumulus is situated some distance inside the perimeter, near but not at the centre of the monument"}

{"id": "94e00540-1ff6-4687-8c62-1b9621a2ad26", "value": "\"Town defences not only provided protection against attack, they also formed barriers which permitted control of movement to and from the town; in addition, one of the most important functions of town gates was as customs posts where tolls were collected.\" \n \n \"A fortified town has strong walls that can be defended against enemies.\""}

{"id": "d69180cb-7657-4095-b828-0453f0834347", "value": "\"Les d\u00e9fenses de la ville ne fournissaient pas seulement une protection contre les attaques, elles formaient \u00e9galement des barri\u00e8res qui permettaient de contr\u00f4ler les mouvements vers et depuis la ville ; en outre, l'une des fonctions les plus importantes des portes de la ville \u00e9tait de servir de postes de douane o\u00f9 les p\u00e9ages \u00e9taient per\u00e7us.\""}
{"id": "29e92082-0afa-407a-8fb6-c943cbec8003", "value": "An area and/or one or more structures designated for religious worship (not including Muslim, Christian, or Jewish)"}

{"id": "5bf1a354-a9a0-41f8-93f7-4504146337d4", "value": "Building or space whose function refers to the management or direction of public or private property\n Used for the organisation of a particular group - for instance, the seat of a government of a state."}

{"id": "1ac1b4f6-403a-4645-aa37-5b030a7bc4b2", "value": "\u00c9difice ou espace dont la fonction renvoie \u00e0 la gestion ou direction des biens publiques ou priv\u00e9s.\n Utilis\u00e9 pour l'organisation d'un groupe particulier - par exemple, le si\u00e8ge du gouvernement d'un \u00c9tat."}

{"id": "f1a9564f-6e2c-4243-9f8f-d4bd9ba52d8f", "value": "Les carri\u00e8res sont des espaces (colline, mare ou gisement de minerais), souvent \u00e0 ciel ouvert, exploit\u00e9s pour l\u2019obtention des mati\u00e8res premi\u00e8res.\n Lieu, g\u00e9n\u00e9ralement une grande fosse profonde, d'o\u00f9 sont ou ont \u00e9t\u00e9 extraites des pierres ou d'autres mat\u00e9riaux."}

{"id": "37f1f5a1-f96c-4228-9904-fed7716827a9", "value": "Quarries are areas (hills, ponds or mineral deposits), often in the open air, that are exploited to obtain raw materials. \n A place, typically a large, deep pit, from which stone or other materials are or have been extracted"}
{"id": "db259b91-677a-44f2-8d78-081f5b7ec9f5", "value": "A structure which specifically designates and/or formalises a liminal space or marks an intersection (e.g. Tetrapylon)"}
{"id": "d912bb73-fdd2-44ca-bbc2-15ef166015c0", "value": "Structures ou conceptions architecturales associ\u00e9es \u00e0 des s\u00e9pultures ou \u00e0 des rituels fun\u00e9raires."}

{"id": "d96428c7-ac57-4894-ba50-c162bfa1e9d7", "value": "An area of ground in which deceased individuals are buried\n Structures or architectural designs that are associated with burials or burial rituals."}
{"id": "e9a9d0f5-20a0-4f1d-a1e0-f467a17b0dbf", "value": "A natural outcropping of rock which has a sheltered space underneath"}
{"id": "b3fda820-a328-402a-a7b0-7327dffa7d29", "value": "Affleurement naturel de la roche sous lequel se trouve un espace abrit\u00e9."}
{"id": "f9394e81-eece-4316-85c8-4fa052d7ab69", "value": "Inhumation humaine dans une fourmili\u00e8re ou une termiti\u00e8re."}
{"id": "fddc8aba-ecea-481a-a6c9-82e9dd536a74", "value": "Human burial into an anthill or termite mound."}
{"id": "4c865e13-fa80-4767-a79c-e089a541f15e", "value": "Tumulus with short extensions, shaped like a pastrycroissant. May face East-West. Often sited on a hillock."}

{"id": "0f9a3419-be75-481f-a167-e99ed0209e9e", "value": "Il s'agit d'un dispositif de dissimulation ou d'un abri pour les chasseurs ou les gardes-chasse, compos\u00e9 d'un alignement de petits cairns utilis\u00e9s pour tendre des embuscades au gibier."}
{"id": "5724ea6f-d149-4165-9a30-e34c66b34814", "value": "This is a concealment device or shelter for hunters or gamekeepers, composed of an alignment of small cairns used to ambush wild game"}

{"id": "158fe7e9-529f-4372-8c08-277b3875eedf", "value": "A structure or set of structures, which is marked out or conspicuous in some way in comparison to surrounding structures. The building may be noteworthy due to its large size, setting, decoration etc."}
{"id": "13ec20ac-1066-4944-a6ec-e190413000e7", "value": "The workplace of an iron smith and is sometines called a smithy containing a forge or hearth for heating metals"}
{"id": "7b8ea438-8886-43aa-b686-5ca4418d4d13", "value": "Lieu de travail d'un forgeron, parfois appel\u00e9 \"smithy\" forge, contenant une forge ou un foyer pour chauffer les m\u00e9taux."}
{"id": "78b308a2-4c9d-41bd-89e6-3d72caf93795", "value": "Un monticule o\u00f9 se trouvait un \u00e9tablissement.\n \n Tertre/Butte : un gros tas de terre, de pierres, etc. comme une petite colline."}
{"id": "5c16b5c6-3612-4a19-a868-f7469c089042", "value": "A mound where a settlement was located.x\n \n Mound: a large pile of earth, stones, etc. like a small hill."}
{"id": "e3535d9e-fb02-40fa-b91f-9812fc5fcf56", "value": "Mound, elevation of land, relief."}
{"id": "42b0e620-a878-4ea0-8fb7-bae5b1a2faac", "value": "Tertre, \u00e9l\u00e9vation de terrain, relief."}
{"id": "0f9592b3-050f-466e-9993-269459083261", "value": "Grande installation souterraine de stockage d'eau."}
{"id": "4419fc96-37e6-4c96-8a80-f85f780db258", "value": "Large underground water storage facility."}
{"id": "e583040b-65fa-44ad-958e-320b9ace0d38", "value": "A tower used primarily for the purpose of observation and signalling"}

{"id": "9d3d7106-919c-40b8-80c1-771d4709c6ce", "value": "Elements associated with presses, including orthostats, press beds, counterweights etc. **NB for counting purposes, estimate the number of presses this represents, not the number of individual elements."}

{"id": "bad8b48c-556b-4964-93c9-d7c002338968", "value": "Broader term referring to sites which are believed to have a spiritual significance and/or that are related to the disposal or treatment of the dead"}

{"id": "71966f1b-eb52-4731-9c16-537e27f82976", "value": "Terme g\u00e9n\u00e9ral d\u00e9signant les sites auxquels on attribue une signification spirituelle et/ou qui sont li\u00e9s au traitement des morts."}
{"id": "fa21870f-2d2c-44d7-aa8e-5277a56b60c4", "value": "Any watercraft whose main function is the transport of goods or cargo"}
{"id": "61bf6f4f-e3ea-43e3-b0ee-312b525696b0", "value": "Alternative au site alluvial. Un site situ\u00e9 sur une plaine inondable avec des d\u00e9p\u00f4ts alluviaux."}
{"id": "090bd4bd-70ad-413b-95a9-5bc6b00da2d2", "value": "Alternative to Alluvial Site. A site located on a flood plain with alluvial deposits."}

{"id": "25b2426d-a5c9-4a6a-98d5-c59d8fe2fa47", "value": "The defining feature of a corbeille is a circular or subcircular perimeter constructed from fl at stones or slabs embedded in the ground and usually angled outwards. Di Lernia et al. (2013) have excavated 26 corbeilles on the Messak Settafet (Libyan Fezzan) and published\nradiocarbon dates from 17 of these features, demonstrating that (along with tumuli, stone platforms and stone rings) they were associated with the ritual slaughter of large animals, predominantly cattle, and the interment of their remains, during the middle to late 6th millennium BP. Some of these monuments, including corbeilles, incorporate or are associated with standing stones on which cattle have been engraved (di Lernia 2006; di Lernia and Gallinaro 2010; di Lernia et al. 2013)."}

{"id": "14327b65-3a9f-41b1-a721-e4b398a617a4", "value": "mine [MC].
 Any kind of excavation into the ground for the purpose of extracting
 some kind of raw material such as stone, metal ore, coal, or flint. The
 simplest mines are basically pits sunk into the ground to find or follow
 outcrops of the desired material; these can be described as open–cast mines
 . Lines of shallow extraction pits following surface outcrops of metal ore
 are known as rakes . Deeper, rather cylindrical holes may be described as
 simple shaft mines . Examples where the shaft is expanded at the bottom to
 maximize the area available for extracting a particular layer of material are
 known as bell pits . Shafts that provide access to a series of galleries that
 follow seams of material underground are known as galleried shaft mines .
 Pits that run horizontally into a hill slope or cliff following material into the
 slope are known as adits or drift mines . The techniques of mining
 developed steadily from Neolithic times onwards in most parts of the world,
 the use of fire-setting and stone mauls being the commonest way of
 extracting hard rocks until hardened iron or steel tools became available in later medieval times. The use of drills and explosives appears from the 18th
 century ad. In prehistoric times, soft rock such as gravel or chalk was
 excavated using bone and antler tools and stone and flint axes. The
 archaeology of mines and mining is often rather complicated because as
 well as the underground elements (which are often well preserved) there
 will be surface structures including spoil heaps, processing areas, working
 floors, a range of shelters and facilities, drainage works, and perhaps
 aqueducts, leats, reservoirs, and other water management works where
 water power was used or where material removed from the mine itself
 needed to be washed.
 
 Pit
 An area (hole, shaft, cavity) dug out by humans for storage, food preparation, refuse disposal, etc. These include are storage pits/silos, rubbish dumps or “borrow pits,” and remains of pit dwellings. When left undisturbed by man, pits erode and fill, in a similar sequence to ditches. Frequently they have been used for waste disposal and contain large quantities of food debris and rubbish from hearths."}

{"id": "7e8ced18-e1a4-4d36-9e46-eebbc388b8bc", "value": "mine [MC].
 Tout type d'excavation dans le sol dans le but d'extraire une matière première telle que la pierre, le minerai métallique, le charbon ou le silex. Les mines les plus simples sont essentiellement des puits creusés dans le sol pour trouver ou suivre des affleurements du matériau désiré ; elles peuvent être décrites comme des mines à ciel ouvert. Les lignes de puits d'extraction peu profonds qui suivent les affleurements de minerai métallique sont appelées râteaux/andaineur. Les trous plus profonds et plutôt cylindriques peuvent être décrits comme des mines à puits simple. Les exemples où le puits est élargi au fond pour maximiser la surface disponible pour l'extraction d'une couche particulière de matériau sont connus sous le nom de puits en cloche. Les puits qui donnent accès à une série de galeries qui suivent des filons de matériaux souterrains sont connus sous le nom de mines à puits en galerie. Les puits qui s'enfoncent horizontalement dans la pente d'une colline ou d'une falaise en suivant le matériau dans la pente sont appelés adits ou drift. Les techniques d'exploitation minière se sont développées régulièrement à partir de l'époque néolithique dans la plupart des régions du monde, l'utilisation de l'allumage du feu et des maillots de pierre étant le moyen le plus commun pour extraire les roches dures jusqu'à ce que des outils en fer ou en acier durci soient disponibles à la fin de l'époque médiévale. L'utilisation de forets et d'explosifs apparaît à partir du 18e siècle. À l'époque préhistorique, les roches tendres telles que le gravier ou la craie étaient extraites à l'aide d'outils en os et en bois de cerf et de haches en pierre et en silex. L'archéologie des mines et de l'exploitation minière est souvent assez compliquée car, en plus des éléments souterrains (qui sont souvent bien préservés), il y aura des structures de surface, y compris des terrils, des zones de traitement, des étages de travail, une série d'abris et d'installations, des ouvrages de drainage, et peut-être des aqueducs, des fossés, des réservoirs et d'autres ouvrages de gestion de l'eau lorsque l'énergie hydraulique était utilisée ou lorsque les matériaux extraits de la mine devaient être lavés.
 
 Puits
 Une zone (trou, puits, cavité) creusée par l'homme pour le stockage, la préparation des aliments, l'élimination des déchets, etc. Il s'agit notamment de fosses/silos de stockage, de décharges ou de "fosses d'emprunt", et de vestiges d'habitations en fosse. Lorsqu'elles ne sont pas perturbées par l'homme, les fosses s'érodent et se remplissent, selon une séquence similaire à celle des fossés. Elles ont souvent été utilisées pour l'élimination des déchets et contiennent de grandes quantités de débris alimentaires et de déchets provenant de foyers."}

{"id": "71852002-4126-404b-b265-c915cf32ccfb", "value": "Disc tumuli, or stone discs, are relatively flat circular features, up to c. 0.50m high by c. 7.50m in diameter, outlined by small boulders, or boulders piled to at least two courses. Interior space is filled with slabs or, sometimes, with gravel. Discs in some studies are distinguished from platforms by height and the number of stone courses. Discs in some studies are distinguished from platforms by height and the number of stone courses. Both Milburn (1993) and Paris (1996) refer to this type of tumulus as a \u2018platform\u2019 cairn or monument. Paris goes further to subdivide his \u2018monuments en plate-forme\u2019 into \u2018tumulus en plate-forme surbaiss\u00e9e\u2019 (also presented as \u2018tumulus disco\u00efde\u2019 in his more specific excavation citations), \u2018plate-formes cylindriques \u00e0 gravillons\u2019 and \u2018plate-formes cylindriques empierr\u00e9es\u2019 (Paris 1996, 21). In the BANI (1994) typology, these forms are described as tumulus disco\u00efde, plate-forme cylindriques, and plate-forme empierr\u00e9es respectively."}

{"id": "e03f9f0c-08a2-4dd8-97c3-3a0868ca09b9", "value": "Consists of a main stone structure which is in the form of a U (it does NOT have three distinct sides). A distinctly-seperate structure is placed at the \"entry\" to this larger monument. The structure(s) placed basically to East of the main monument can vary greatly, typically stone emplacements, or short, linear stone constructions. Nomenclature seems haphazard, even interchangeable.(Milburn, 1993) .For visuals, See: https://archaeoland.eu/en/sahara-en/u-and-l-monuments"}
